verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a hosted KYC/KYB solution that platforms integrate for all user types, and a pre-built UI component for users to securely register bank account details as a Recipient. That covers hosted verification and an embeddable bank-linking component, but nothing in the pack shows terms-of-service acceptance or the API calls for creating and onboarding sellers. Missing for 10: terms acceptance capability, API-level documentation of the seller onboarding flow (user creation, KYB document and UBO submission), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can onboard a seller through the API — KYB and KYC, bank account linking, and terms acceptance — with hosted flows and embeddable components when I don't want to build the forms

citations.quote: Mangopay's [hosted KYC/KYB](/guides/users/verification/hosted) solution, which your platform must integrate for all user types
Mangopay provides a pre-built UI component that you can integrate to allow users to securely register their bank account details directly with Mangopay as a Recipient.
